# Rule: Public inline body's compiled-in dependency changed

_Canonical rule slug:_ `public-consumer-compiled-dependency-changed`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A public inline or template body is compiled into every consumer that includes its header, and the declarations it calls or references changed, so consumers must recompile. Header-graph risk to review; no consumer build evidence says which consumers include the header, so it is never a proven break.
